candidate_performance_acceptance.scope: One paused two-member Client scenery Group, Undo and Redo in two isolated peers.
candidate_performance_acceptance.measurement_limits: One paused two-member sample; diagnostic confirmation includes polling. This is not a rendered FPS or general latency measurement. Native259 used larger Group shapes and is not directly comparable.

selection.scope: Client mixed Building and Scenery Move, Undo and Redo in two isolated peers.

duplicate.scope: Building Duplicate, Undo and Redo after Client-only Service cache resolution in two isolated peers.

group.scope: Seven confirmed scenery Group and Ungroup operations and history actions across two isolated peers.
group.subsequent_action: unknown after observation timeout; no replay

history_followup.scope: Client Group, Undo and Redo in two isolated peers.

followup.observation_timeouts: Two initial UI observations timed out; later paired ordered evidence confirmed the actions. Retained logs show main-thread network dispatch gaps of 25-32 seconds; the cause remains under investigation.

limits: These are local isolated two-peer small-world runs, not separate-account Steam acceptance.
Historical runs used the candidate hashes recorded for each run; they are not a claim that the final candidate was used in each run.
Complete world-state equality, large worlds, four peers and all gameplay families remain unproven.
The package declares the Framework minimum; native admission checks ABI and services, not runtime semantic version.
